# Entertaining Safety

> > Comprehensive resource for entertainment industry safety, theatrical rigging, atmospheric effects, and ETCP certification preparation.

Entertaining Safety provides evidence-based guidance on stage safety, theatrical fog and atmospheric effects, rigging practices, and professional certification. The site draws on research from organizations like NIOSH, CDC, ATSDR, and industry bodies including USITT and Actors' Equity Association to support entertainment technicians and safety professionals.

## Key Topics

- ETCP certification and BACKstage Exam preparation
- Theatrical fog and atmospheric effects safety
- Propylene glycol, ethylene glycol, and triethylene glycol
- Stage rigging and theatrical rigging practices
- USITT standards and guidelines
- Health hazards in entertainment environments
- Workers' Compensation Board of BC regulations
- NIOSH and CDC research on entertainment safety
- Actors' Equity Association safety protocols
- SHAPE (Safety and Health in Arts Production and Entertainment)
- Lighting design safety considerations
- Audio engineering and event safety
- Theatre technology best practices
- BC Lung Association research on fog effects
- Mineral oil-based atmospheric effects

## Getting Started

- [Entertaining Safety](https://entertainingsafety.com): Homepage for theater safety, stage rigging, and ETCP training resources
